ModMetaData.name: Raiders Have Families
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.7: real faction-radio prisoner negotiations after arrival at comms console; multi-stage hostage dialogue; proper distinction between ransom amounts and acceptance probability; surgery evidence for WCE2 and vanilla organ harvesting; actual goodwill vs internal faction tension; clickable ransom-delivery notification; ranks 0-8 and social provenance; bounded event-driven AI and dedicated developer test actions with rank-by-click spawns. Experimental v0.6.0, save backup advised.
